import bpy, math
ns=bpy.app.driver_namespace['harbor_craft']
exec("""
# Trim the gable planks to the actual underside of the roof, not stepped rectangles.
for o in list(c.objects):
    if (o.name.startswith('Gable ') and not o.name.startswith(('Gable vent','Gable fascia'))) or o.name.startswith(('Craft gable infill','Craft gable lining','Canopy diagonal brace')):
        bpy.data.objects.remove(o,do_unlink=True)
slope=math.atan2(1.40,3.05);pitch=math.tan(slope);peak=4.265
for x in [-2.325,2.325]:
    for row in range(8):
        z=2.98+row*.18
        zlo=z-.086;zhi=min(z+.086,peak-.004)
        center=(zlo+zhi)/2;height=zhi-zlo
        half=min(2.67,(peak-center)/pitch)
        segments=[(-half,half)] if not (3.08<center<3.59) else [(-half,-.28),(.28,half)]
        for j,(a,b) in enumerate(segments):
            if b-a<.012:continue
            ob=plank('Craft gable infill %s %02d %d'%(x,row,j),(x,a,center),(x,b,center),height,.055,row%12,(1 if x>0 else -1,0,0),.003)
            # Each outer end follows the roof slope, while vent jambs stay upright.
            for vert in ob.data.vertices:
                wz=(ob.matrix_world@vert.co).z
                hh=min(2.67,max(.004,(peak-wz)/pitch))
                t=vert.co.x/(b-a)
                aa=-hh if a==-half else a;bb=hh if b==half else b
                vert.co.x=aa+(bb-aa)*t-a
            ob.data.update()
# Support both canopy diagonals against a real rafter immediately below the roof.
for x in [-.85,2.15]:
    beam('Craft canopy rafter '+str(x),(x,-2.63,2.61),(x,-4.23,2.17),.115,.12,20,normal=(1,0,0))
    beam('Craft canopy knee '+str(x),(x,-4.17,1.66),(x,-3.56,2.355),.075,.08,20,normal=(1,0,0))
for o in c.objects:
    if o.name.startswith('Eave carrier') and not o.get('cleared_roof'):
        o.location.z-=.07;o['cleared_roof']=True
print('GABLE_AND_CANOPY_CONNECTIONS_FIXED',len(c.objects))
""",ns)
